payload.description:
Implement policy checks outside the model.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every connector, network egress, file transfer, credential use, and consequential action checks the task grant.
- Browser contexts cannot share forbidden credentials or storage.
- Approval records bind an operation digest and reject mutation or replay outside their scope.
- Denials are durable, tenant-scoped, and visible without exposing secrets.
- The model cannot change policy through tool arguments or page content.
payload.title: Enforce browser capability and approval policy at system sinks
